tooltip.somakespells.red_soul_lantern.in: Keep it in your inventory and cast different Spirit spells to store their magic.
message.somakespells.red_soul_lantern.ab: The lantern absorbed a Spirit spell (%1$s/%2$s).

message.somakespells.winged_ruin.insuffi: At least 21 seconds of Red Soul are required to cast Winged Ruin.

spell.somakespells.combustion.guide: Applies Combustion to yourself, granting Fire Spell Power and Fire damage bonus for a certain period of time.
spell.somakespells.ritual_flame.guide: Launches a ritual flame at the Altar of Fire you are aiming at. If the setup is correct, the pedestal ritual begins.
spell.somakespells.damned_demomans.guide: Applies the Demned Demomans effect to yourself, arming an effect that makes you explode in flames.
spell.somakespells.eruption.guide: Aim at the ground to summon an eruption that deals area damage.
spell.somakespells.fire_blast.guide: Fire long-range compressed fire beams that can hit targets in front of you.
spell.somakespells.firestorm_vortex.guid: Summons a fiery vortex at the target point that pulls nearby enemies inward and scorches them over time.
spell.somakespells.pumpkin_bomb.guide: Throw an explosive pumpkin that deals impact and area damage.
spell.somakespells.ignis_shield.guide: Summons an Ignis Shield with limited health to protect you from frontal impacts.
spell.somakespells.incinerator_slash.gui: Launches a devastating incinerating slash that deals direct fire damage.
spell.somakespells.abyssal_burn.guide: Conjures magic circles on the ground, expelling abyssal flames into the air.
spell.somakespells.fire_orbs.guide: Summons several flame orbs that fall from the sky and hit enemies.
spell.somakespells.abyssal_orbs.guide: Summons several abyssal orbs that fall from the sky and hit enemies with direct impact.
spell.somakespells.apocalyptic_burst.gui: Charges and releases a devastating explosion with high area damage.
spell.somakespells.earthbound.guide: Applies Earthbound to yourself, granting Geo and Armor bonus for a certain period of time.
spell.somakespells.submerge.guide: Applies Submerged to yourself, increasing Aqua Spell Power and Aquatic Mobility for a period of time.
spell.somakespells.tidal_grasp.guide: Throws a large anchor that drags the enemy toward you.
spell.somakespells.tsunami.guide: Summons giant waves that deal damage to targets in their path.
spell.somakespells.tidal_dash.guide: Throws a summoned anchor that launches you toward the enemy.
spell.somakespells.thunder_cloud.guide: Conjures a Thunder Cloud that repeatedly strikes with Rain and Lightning.
spell.somakespells.water_control.guide: Keeps a suspended mass of water in front of you, following your aim while you channel it.
spell.somakespells.water_spear.guide: Launches a summoned water spear projectile at the target.
spell.somakespells.hydro_slash.guide: Conjures a water slash that deals damage to enemies in front. Damage gains bonus based on the sword in hand.
spell.somakespells.sea_serpent.guide: Summons the Scylla serpent, dealing damage to targets in front of you.
spell.somakespells.sea_serpent_jet.guide: Fires a Scylla serpent jet from the ground, dealing damage.
spell.somakespells.storm_aura.guide: Creates a storm aura around you that pulls in enemies and explodes at the end, knocking everyone away.
spell.somakespells.water_ball.guide: Throws a water ball projectile that deals damage on impact.
spell.somakespells.summon_drowned.guide: Summons an allied Drowned whose health and damage scale with Aqua power.
spell.somakespells.lightning_spear.guide: Throws a summoned lightning spear projectile that deals damage.
spell.somakespells.ender_corruption.guid: Inflicts Ender Corruption on yourself, granting Ender Spell Power bonus for a long period of time.
spell.somakespells.phantom_barrage.guide: Summons several cursed arrows that fly toward the target.
spell.somakespells.overgrowth.guide: Applies Overgrowth to yourself, granting Nature Spell Power bonus and increased bow damage.
spell.somakespells.permafrost.guide: Applies Permafrost to yourself, granting Ice Spell Power and cold damage bonus.
spell.somakespells.blessing.guide: Applies Blessing to yourself, granting Holy Spell Power and healing received bonus.
spell.somakespells.custodia_caeli.guide: Marks the ground you are aiming at with a sacred preparation circle, then calls down Custodia Caeli, a rotating sigil that blesses every player inside with a long-lasting defensive buff that scales with spell level.
spell.somakespells.sovereign_armory.guid: Opens a golden armory of portals behind the caster, then fires its conjured weapons in sequence at the aimed target.
spell.somakespells.blood_rush.guide: Applies Blood Dash to yourself, granting Blood Spell Power bonus and life steal on damage dealt.
spell.somakespells.blood_cut.guide: Applies Blood Cut to yourself so your attacks deal increased blood cut damage.
spell.somakespells.bloody_legacy.guide: Delivers a blow that strikes the ground, dealing damage to all enemies in a straight line.
spell.somakespells.bloodmark.guide: Four casts mark points, then the next cast links them into a blood zone that persists and damages targets inside.
spell.somakespells.bloodbound_blade.guid: Hurls the sword in your casting hand. A successful hit crystallizes the victim's blood, rooting them in place.
spell.somakespells.fragmented_requiem.gu: Summons a perfect ring of fragmented swords from the earth. They cut once on the rise, hover briefly, then plunge back down for a second blood-soaked strike.
spell.somakespells.cursed_connection.gui: Links two targets with a cursed bond that shares a portion of damage between them until the effect expires or the targets move too far apart.
spell.somakespells.blessed_connection.gu: Links two targets with a blessed bond that shares a portion of healing between them until the effect expires or the targets move too far apart.
spell.somakespells.guardian_connection.g: Links you to a target with a holy bond. While the bond lasts and you remain alive, the target becomes immune to damage and every prevented hit is redirected to you.
spell.somakespells.eldritch_gambit.guide: Applies Eldritch Gambit to yourself as a temporary eldritch buff.
spell.somakespells.chain_connection.guid: Binds two targets with an arcane chain, preventing them from moving too far away from each other.
spell.somakespells.evocation_fortitude.g: Applies Evocation Fortitude, granting Evocation Spell Power bonus.
spell.somakespells.reverberation.guide: Applies Reverberation, granting Sound Spell Power bonus for a certain period of time.
spell.somakespells.slumber_melody.guide: Plays a melody that puts nearby enemies to sleep.
spell.somakespells.resonant_pulse.guide: Releases a resonant pulse projectile that deals sonic damage.
spell.somakespells.ram_tchum.guide: Conjures a heavy sonic explosion that deals area damage.
spell.somakespells.jingle_bell.guide: Summons a bell that chimes, dealing area damage with each chime.
spell.somakespells.comforting_lullaby.gu: Channels a melody that heals nearby injured players in pulses, including the caster, but also makes each healed player Sleepy.
spell.somakespells.lightning_ball.guide: Throws a lightning ball that deals area damage.
spell.somakespells.lightning_dance.guide: Launches multiple lightning spears at nearby targets.
spell.somakespells.lightning_field.guide: Creates an electricity field that electrocutes the ground and deals continuous damage to enemies.
spell.somakespells.lightning_strike.guid: Summons a lightning strike and electrocutes the target.
spell.somakespells.lightning_cut.guide: Performs a lightning cut that deals damage and electrocutes the target.
spell.somakespells.lightning_swarm.guide: Releases a swarm of electric sparks against multiple targets.
spell.somakespells.lightning_lash.guide: Cracks a lightning whip in front to deal direct damage and quickly pull the enemy toward you.
spell.somakespells.halberd_strike.guide: Summons 3 frontal columns of phantom halberds to strike distant enemies.
spell.somakespells.mirror_strike.guide: Creates mirrored circles around you to deal area damage.
spell.somakespells.render_rush.guide: Performs a frontal dash, dealing damage to anyone in the path.
spell.somakespells.axe_cleave.guide: Summons spectral axe cleaves to cut targets in front.
spell.somakespells.desert_wrath.guide: Summons tornadoes around you that deal damage on impact.
spell.somakespells.soul_grab.guide: Maledictus Charge: upon selecting a target, you grab the enemy, launch yourself upward, and slam down with full force, dealing impact damage.
spell.somakespells.procession_of_souls.g: Summons a procession of spiritual eruptions in a straight line in front of you.
spell.somakespells.grave_sigil.guide: Marks a grave sigil on the ground, then detonates it in two soul-charged waves: first a cross, then an X of spectral eruptions.
spell.somakespells.soul_bastion.guide: Replicates the Possessed Paladin's soul shield assault, calling one outer ring of shields inward and a second inner ring outward.
spell.somakespells.soul_latch.guide: Latches onto a target with a spectral stab, binding and pulling it toward you before dealing damage in a final releasing burst.
spell.somakespells.spiral_of_ruin.guide: Hurls a spectral trident that unfurls a telegraphed spiral of soul eruptions from its point of impact.
spell.somakespells.soulfall_judgment.gui: Unleashes a soul-charged impact around the caster and calls down a cyan-green formation of spectral blades.
spell.somakespells.soul_reprisal.guide: Launches six cyan spectral daggers in a forward fan. The daggers reverse course after a short distance and can strike enemies again along their return path.
spell.somakespells.spectral_rondo.guide: Charges forward in a spectral spin, striking twice in 360 degrees while three parallel trails of cyan Soul Pillars erupt along the path.
spell.somakespells.winged_ruin.guide: Unfurls the Possessed Paladin's original crimson wings, rises amid converging souls and dives into a selected point, unleashing the Finisher's four cardinal formations of Soul Pillar Explosions.
spell.somakespells.spirit_empowerment.gu: Applies Spirit Empowerment to yourself, granting Spirit Spell Power bonus.
Applies Symmetry Empowerment to yourself, granting Symmetry Spell Power bonus.
§8-You go into a rampage when your health is low
spell.somakespells.rose_secret.guide: Wrap yourself in the Rose's Secret, becoming briefly untouchable while withered petals fall around you.
effect.somakespells.rose_secret.descript: Negates all incoming damage for a short time.
item.somakespells.fire.desc.1: An untamed flame, hungry for flesh and mana.
item.somakespells.fire.desc.2: While held, it scorches its bearer.
item.somakespells.soul_fire.desc.1: A spectral ember, cold to the touch and cruel to the soul.
item.somakespells.soul_fire.desc.2: While held, it wreathes its bearer in soul flame.
item.somakespells.infernal_fire.desc.1: A cursed blaze, torn from profane and ravenous furnaces.
item.somakespells.infernal_fire.desc.2: While held, it brands its bearer with infernal flame.
ui.somakespells.ritual_flame.invalid_tar: Aim at an Altar of Fire to start the ritual.
ui.somakespells.ritual_flame.no_recipe: No valid ritual was found on that altar.
ui.somakespells.ritual_flame.already_act: That altar is already conducting a ritual.
ui.somakespells.ritual_flame.requires_so: This ritual requires Ritual Flame in Soul Fire mode.
ui.somakespells.ritual_flame.requires_in: This ritual requires Ritual Flame in Infernal Fire mode.
jei.somakespells.soul_blaze_rod.info.1: Use Ritual Flame in Soul Fire mode on a normal Blaze to transform it into a Soul Blaze.
jei.somakespells.soul_blaze_rod.info.2: Soul Blaze Rods drop from the transformed Soul Blaze.
jei.somakespells.infernal_blaze_rod.info: Use Ritual Flame in Infernal Fire mode on a Soul Blaze to transform it into an Infernal Blaze.
Infernal Blaze Rods drop from the transformed Infernal Blaze.
Summons a tornado of withered rose petals at the target point. The vortex drags enemies inward, lifts them, deals Blood damage in pulses, and afflicts them with Wither.
death.attack.somakespells.withered_rose_: %1$s was torn apart by %2$s's Withered Rose Vortex
spell.somakespells.funeral_bloom.guide: Conjures a vast withered rose above the target area. In repeated waves, closed rose buds fall toward enemies, telegraph their impact, and bloom violently on the ground, dealing Blood damage and applying Wither. Striking already-withered enemies restores health to the caster.
death.attack.somakespells.sacred_phoenix: %1$s was consumed by %2$s's Sacred Phoenix Blessing
spell.somakespells.sacred_phoenix_blessi: Binds the caster to an allied player through the blessing of a sacred phoenix, suspending the caster above the ally while a fiery crimson aura follows them and periodically damages nearby enemies. The caster remains vulnerable and completely incapacitated, then suffers exhaustion when the blessing ends.
